answer: Admission auction: each epoch only 100 slots open, agents bid POA for one; a winning bid locks for 20 epochs. An attacker wanting 100 fakes must outbid honest agents 100 times: 30 POA a slot means 3,000 POA locked, against 2 POA per fake. Honest agents pay once, earn it back through real work. The dune of cheap fakes collapses once each grain costs money. A violet badge marks each bid; a whisper network flags rented badges, forcing re-auction.
